page.overview:
Who is Bulletman?

Bulletman came to the rescue when a river overflowed and threatened to flood a town. He smashed through a mountain to remove a piece which he used to block the river. All this was observed by G.I. Joe and Mike Power who suggested that he should join the Adventure Team and Bulletman agreed.

In Revolutionaries #3, the third issue of a major Hasbro crossover comic event from IDW, there's a flashback stroy called The Secret of the Mummy's Tomb where the Adventure Team, consisting of Joe Colton, Bulletman, Atomic Man, Stalker and Mayhem, face off against Evil Robot Mummies.

Bullet Man appears in the Rob Liefeld produced, 5 issue comic mini series, G.I. Joe: Snake Eyes - Deadgame, from IDW Publishing. Bullet Man joins Mike Power: Atomic Man and Joe Colton, aka G.I. Joe, in helping Snake Eyes, Scarlett and Storm Shadow in facing off against the red mummy, Kirigun.

The toy featured a new sculpted head with painted hair and a pair of hard hands that were now chrome to go with his steel arms. The chrome-plated figure was also part of the last wave of vintage GI Joe Adventure Team figures.
